summary: Enumerated every declared object-store consumer across docker-compose.yml/docker-compose.control.yml and services/**/*.py, found zero real S3/MinIO I/O consumers and one real consumer already on Google Cloud Storage, compared local-S3-replacement vs managed-store vs retirement, produced a reproducible isolated round-trip proof against the real adapter, recorded the accepted choice, and designed the core/workers/research/management-ai/execution source-profile contract per the accepted environment-identity plan.

artifacts_produced.purpose: Full read-only enumeration of every docker-compose service declaring PANTHEON_S3_* env vars or depends_on minio, plus the repo-wide non-test search for boto3/botocore/S3-client usage (zero hits), and the one real object-store consumer (management_ai_store.py on GCS).

Compares the 3 acceptance-bounded options (maintained local S3-compatible replacement, existing managed object store, documented retirement), records the accepted decision (GCS as sole backend; retire the unused MinIO layer), and carries the reproducible isolated proof.

Design-only core/workers/research/management-ai/execution profile contract with health/dependency/volume/isolation requirements, aligned to SA.md's accepted environment-identity plan and to the storage decision (no profile's health depends on MinIO).

consumer_enumeration.method: grep across docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.control.yml, docker-compose.remote-dev.yml, docker-compose.exec.yml for PANTHEON_S3_ENDPOINT/PANTHEON_ARTIFACT_BUCKET/minio, and a repo-wide non-test grep for boto3/botocore/S3 client construction under services/ and scripts/
consumer_enumeration.result: 17 services (main stack) / 12 services (control stack) declare the four PANTHEON_S3_* env vars; only 8/9 of those add a depends_on: minio: condition: service_healthy edge. Zero non-test source files construct an S3 client. The two files that read the env vars (services/foundation/persistence_posture.py, services/source_search_posture.py) only check presence for a staging/prod posture gate and explicitly document that they never open a connection.
consumer_enumeration.real_consumer: services/control-plane/bff/management_ai_store.py already uses google-cloud-storage (Apache-2.0), gated by PANTHEON_MGMT_AI_ATTACH_BUCKET, with a local-filesystem fallback when unset; unrelated to PANTHEON_S3_*.

options_compared.option: A: replace MinIO with another maintained local S3-compatible server
options_compared.disposition: rejected — no S3-API consumer exists to justify standing up a replacement server; would not help the one real consumer, which already uses GCS

options_compared.option: B: standardize on the existing supported managed object store (Google Cloud Storage)
options_compared.disposition: accepted — already integrated, already budgeted in RESOURCE_AND_COST_MODEL.md (~$6/month), already proven in isolation, matches the all-GCP environment-identity plan

options_compared.option: C: documented retirement (no real consumer/data remains)
options_compared.disposition: folded into the accepted decision, scoped to the MinIO/S3 layer only — object storage itself is not retired, the redundant self-hosted layer with zero consumers is

isolated_proof.command: sys.path.insert(0, 'services/control-plane'); import bff.management_ai_store as mas — full script in storage-topology-decision.md §4

profile_contract_design.scope_boundary: design/document only; no docker-compose.yml/docker-compose.control.yml edit was made, no hostname was provisioned, no data was migrated, no runtime was promoted or deployed by this task
